description: Convert text between JSON and YAML with safe parsing, indent, key sorting and minify options, and line-accurate error messages. Cost: 1 credit per call. Output: a file (application/json | application/yaml) returned inline, at most 1 MiB. converted.json or converted.yaml; meta: {from, to}

from.description: Source format; auto tries JSON first, then YAML.

indent.description: Spaces per level. JSON: 0 puts items on their own lines without indentation. YAML: values below 2 are treated as 2.

input.description: The JSON or YAML text to convert (up to 2 MB).

minify.description: JSON: single line without spaces. YAML: single-line flow style. Overrides indent.

sort_keys.description: Sort object keys alphabetically (default: keep input order).

to.description: Target format. Default: yaml for JSON input, json for YAML input.

name: json_yaml_convert
title: JSON and YAML converter
